DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報のご変更ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you changing your registered information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯番号が変わり、アプリの認証コードが古い番号に送られてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古い番号への認証送信で利用できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mobile number changed, and the app's verification code goes to the old number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot use the app because verification is sent to the old number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い番号の電話は、まだお使いになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you still use the phone with the old number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう解約しました。新しい番号を登録したいのですが、ログインもできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧番号解約とログイン不可を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've canceled it. I'd like to register the new number, but I can't even log in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the old number is canceled and you cannot log in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口でご本人を確認し、変更担当がご案内します。身分証はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll verify your identity at the counter, then the changes officer will guide you. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、免許証と通帳があります。電話番号以外は変わっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認書類と変更範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, my driving license and passbook. Nothing except the phone number has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your identification documents and the scope of the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この用紙に現在の番号をお書きください。復旧までの振込はお急ぎですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write your current number on this form. Do you need an urgent transfer before access is restored?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日支払う家賃があります。アプリが間に合わなければ、窓口から振り込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日の家賃振込の代替方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have rent to pay tomorrow. If the app isn't ready, can I transfer at the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about an alternative way to transfer tomorrow's rent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 窓口での方法と手数料は、振込担当が説明します。変更と併せてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The transfer officer will explain counter methods and fees. Please discuss both that and the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず新しい番号を書きます。復旧時期と、明日の振込方法を担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新番号を記入し復旧時期と振込を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write the new number first. I'd like to ask the officer when access will be restored and how to transfer tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Enter the new number and discuss restoration timing and the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つのご用件を引き継ぎます。お掛けになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on both requests. Please take a seat and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for dashi stock?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 料理に使う粉末だしを選んでいます。食塩の少ない方を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 粉末だしの食塩を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm choosing powdered stock for cooking. I'd like the one with less salt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare salt in powdered stock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この二つの栄養表示を見ましょう。片方は一袋、片方は一グラム当たりですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at these two nutrition labels. One is per packet, the other per gram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ数字なら同じ量だと思っていました。一袋は何グラムですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示単位の誤解を述べ一袋の量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the same number meant the same amount. How many grams in one packet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding of units and ask the packet amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは八グラム入りです。表示の単位も一緒にご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one contains eight grams. Look at the units as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 八グラムを全部使うなら、こちらの数字を八倍するのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用量への換算を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I use all eight grams, I multiply this number by eight, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm conversion to the amount used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一グラム当たりの方はそうなります。使う量は箱の調理例にもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: For the per-gram one, yes. The cooking examples on the box also show amounts to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人分の汁物なので、半袋から試したいです。開けた残りは保存できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 少量使用と開封後保存を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's soup for two, so I'd like to start with half a packet. Can I store the remainder after opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about using a small amount and storing after opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品は、開封後は袋を閉じて早めに使うと書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This product says to close the packet after opening and use it soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示の単位が分かりました。一袋当たりの塩分が少ないこちらを買い、残りは密閉します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 比較結果から商品と保存方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the units now. I'll buy this one with less salt per packet and seal the remainder tightly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the product and storage method from your comparison. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞレジへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please proceed to checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内のご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions around the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本を読みながら休みたいです。西日の当たらないベンチはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読書できる日陰のベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to rest and read a book. Is there a bench out of the afternoon sun from the west?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a shaded bench where you can read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池の北側なら木陰です。ただ、今日は近くで草刈りをしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: North of the pond has tree shade. However, grass is being cut nearby today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 静かな方がいいので、別の場所にします。東の芝生はどうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 草刈りを避け別の広場を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd prefer somewhere quiet, so I'll choose elsewhere. How about the eastern lawn?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid the mowing and ask about another open area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の時間は日陰ですが、ベンチはありません。敷物をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's shaded now, but there are no benches. Do you have a mat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいシートがあります。芝生に敷いて座ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 敷物を持参し芝生使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a small sheet. May I lay it on the grass and sit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a mat and ask to use the lawn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 東の区画なら使えます。ロープの内側は養生中なので避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the eastern section. Avoid inside the ropes, where the grass is recovering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 区画の手前に座ります。帰りは正門が閉まる前に出たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 養生区画を避け正門の閉鎖を気にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll sit before that section. I'd like to leave through the main gate before it closes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid the protected section and mention the main gate's closing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正門は五時に閉まります。時計は管理棟の壁にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The main gate closes at five. There's a clock on the management building's wall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四時半には本を片付けて、時計を見ながら正門へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読書を終える時間と帰路を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put the book away by 4:30 and head back to the main gate while checking the clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide when to finish reading and your return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら余裕がありますね。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That leaves plenty of time. Enjoy your rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行き先までの経路をお調べですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the route to your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 市民ホールに行きます。足を痛めていて、駅を降りてから長く歩けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩行の負担と目的地を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to the Civic Hall. I've injured my foot and can't walk far after leaving the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your destination and difficulty walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ホールに近い駅と、バスで玄関前まで行く方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a station near the hall, or a bus that takes you to its entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近い駅からでも歩く距離はどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近隣駅からの徒歩距離を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: How far would I walk even from the nearby station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the walking distance from the nearby station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 南口から七百メートルほどです。バスなら東口から乗って、ホール前で降ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: About 700 meters from its south exit. By bus, board at the east exit and get off in front of the hall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それならバスを使います。東口の乗り場まで、途中で座れる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: バスを選び駅内の休憩場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll use the bus. Is there somewhere to sit along the way to the east-exit stop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the bus and ask about a resting place in the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札を出た待合室に椅子があります。乗り場はその先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are chairs in the waiting room outside the gates. The stop is beyond it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待合室で一度休みます。バスに乗る時、降りる停留所を運転手に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩と降車停留所の確認を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll rest in the waiting room first. When boarding, I'd like to confirm my stop with the driver.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Plan a rest and checking the stop where you will get off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行先と「市民ホール前」を伝えてください。こちらに停留所名を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell them your destination and Civic Hall Front. I'll write the stop name here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙を持って東口へ行きます。歩く距離が短い方法に決められました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停留所名を持って東口へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the paper to the east exit. I've chosen the route with less walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the stop name and head to the east exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 東口はこちらです。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The east exit is this way. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の手続きでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外から戻って、昨日この市に住み始めました。前の市の転出証明書はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外転入で転出証明書がないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've returned from overseas and started living in this city yesterday. I don't have a moving-out certificate from the previous city.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss moving in from overseas without a moving-out certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 海外からの転入ですね。帰国した日が分かる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Moving in from overseas, then. Have you something showing the date you returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パスポートがあります。自動ゲートを通ったので、入国のスタンプはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パスポートの入国印がないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my passport. I used the automated gate, so there's no entry stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the passport has no entry stamp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認に使える資料を担当がご案内します。航空券の記録は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The officer will explain documents usable for verification. Do you still have flight records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予約メールと搭乗券の写真があります。新しい住所の契約書も持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰国記録と新住所資料を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: A booking email and boarding-pass photo. I also have the contract for the new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present return-travel records and new-address documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へお見せください。以前この市に住んだことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show them to the officer. Have you lived in this city before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十年前に住んでいました。以前の住所を覚えているので、紙に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 過去の居住歴と住所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ten years ago. I remember the old address, so I'll write it on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your previous residence history and address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報も担当が確認します。こちらが転入の相談窓口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The officer will check that too. Here's the moving-in consultation counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: パスポートと移動の記録、今の住所と以前の住所をまとめて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認資料と二つの住所をまとめ窓口へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll gather my passport, travel records, current address, and old address for the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gather verification documents and both addresses and go to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当にお声掛けください。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please speak to the officer. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change an appointment, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 火曜の診察を金曜へ変えたいです。同じ日に採血もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察と採血の同日変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like Tuesday's consultation changed to Friday. I also have a blood test the same day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request changing the consultation and blood test to the same day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 採血と診察の両方ですね。予約票を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both blood test and consultation. Let me see the appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。診察だけ変えると、採血は火曜のままになってしまいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片方だけ変更される可能性を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. If only the consultation changes, will the blood test stay on Tuesday?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the possibility of only one appointment changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査担当とも調整します。金曜は午前と午後、どちらがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll coordinate with the testing department too. Friday morning or afternoon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午前です。採血前に食事を抜くよう言われていますが、変更後も同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 午前希望と絶食指示の再確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Morning. I was told not to eat before the blood test; does that still apply after the change?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request morning and reconfirm fasting instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査内容を確認して、担当が食事の指示をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking the test, the officer will tell you the food instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。仕事の休みを取るので、二つの時刻が決まってから会社に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つの時刻確定後に勤務調整すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll take leave from work, so I'll tell my company after both times are settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will coordinate work after both times are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 調整できましたら電話します。日中つながる番号はこちらでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll phone once arranged. Is this a number we can reach during the day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この番号にお願いします。新しい時刻と食事の指示を一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 折り返し先と確認したい内容を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please call this number. I'd like to hear the new times and food instructions together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the callback number and what you want to confirm. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へそのように伝えます。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that to the officer. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a bicycle, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: マンションの駐輪場に置いた電動自転車がありません。鍵は持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵を持っている自転車が消えたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My electric bicycle is missing from the apartment's bicycle parking. I have the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a missing bicycle whose key you still hold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に見たのはいつですか。管理の方には尋ねましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you last see it? Have you asked management?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜九時です。管理人さんは移動していないと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終確認時刻と管理者確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nine last night. The caretaker says they haven't moved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the last-seen time and management's response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車体の色と、防犯登録番号が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know the color and have documents with the anti-theft registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 深緑です。登録の控えを携帯で撮ってあります。バッテリーは家で充電中でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色登録資料とバッテリー不在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dark green. I've photographed the registration copy on my phone. The battery was charging at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the color, registration records, and absence of the battery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: バッテリーのない状態だったのですね。他に特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It was without its battery, then. Any other features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前かごに赤いカバーがあります。子ども用の座席は付いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かごなど車体の特徴を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: A red cover on the front basket. No child seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe features such as the basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料を見ながら受付します。お名前と連絡先もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take the report while looking at the records. Your name and contact details too, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えの写真を見せます。昨夜九時から今朝七時までの間になくなったと届けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を見せ発生時間の範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the photo of the registration copy. I'd like to report it went missing between nine last night and seven this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the records and give the time range of the disappearance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでお話を伺います。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll listen here. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送る物のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice on something to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きな図面を折らずに送りたいです。丸めて筒に入れても送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図面を筒で送る可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send a large drawing without folding it. Can I roll it into a tube and send it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a drawing can be sent in a tube. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 長さと太さを測って、扱えるサービスを確認します。筒はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll measure the length and thickness and check eligible services. Do you have a tube?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この筒です。長さは六十センチで、中に図面が三枚あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 筒の寸法と図面枚数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one. It's 60 centimeters long and has three drawings inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the tube dimensions and number of drawings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ふたが外れないように固定してください。宛先は筒の側面に付けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Secure the lid so it won't come off. The address can go on the tube's side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 丸くて転がるので、宛名がはがれない貼り方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名の固定方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's round and rolls, so please show me how to attach the address without it peeling off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to secure the address label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛名の紙を平らに貼り、端を透明テープで押さえられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Lay the address paper flat against it and secure its edges with clear tape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 送り先は事務所です。配達の記録が残る方法も選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送付先と追跡の希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's going to an office. I'd also like a method that leaves a delivery record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the destination and request tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追跡できる方法を、サイズ確認後にご案内します。受取希望日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain trackable methods after checking size. Have you a preferred receipt date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週の会議で使います。間に合う目安を聞いてから、追跡できる方法で出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用日を伝え配達目安と発送方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's for next week's meeting. After hearing the likely arrival time, I'll send it by a trackable method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give when it will be used and discuss delivery estimates and shipping method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では筒を測ります。お送りいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll measure the tube, then. Thank you for sending with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さな修理の仕事を始めました。店の名前で振込を受ける口座を作りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 事業用口座と店名での受取を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've started a small repair business. I'd like an account that receives transfers under the shop name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a business account receiving under your shop name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 事業用の口座ですね。個人事業として営業されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: A business account. Are you operating as a sole proprietor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、法人ではありません。店の名前と私の名前を両方入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個人事業で屋号と本人名の併記を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, not a corporation. Can both the shop name and my name be included?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State sole proprietorship and ask about combining trading and personal names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名義の扱いと必要資料は、口座担当が確認します。事業を示す資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The account officer will check account-name rules and documents. Do you have evidence of the business?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開業の書類と、店の賃貸契約書があります。屋号は「青葉修理」です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 事業資料と屋号を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Business-opening papers and the shop lease. The trading name is Aoba Repairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your business documents and trading name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの資料を担当へお見せください。今使っている口座はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show those to the officer. Do you already have an account in use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 生活費の口座だけです。仕事のお金を分けて管理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 生活用口座から事業金を分けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only my living-expenses account. I want to manage work money separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want business funds separate from your living-expenses account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その用途も伝えます。開設の可否や名義は確認後のご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that purpose on too. Opening eligibility and the name will be explained after checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、屋号入りの名義が使えるか相談します。今日は資料を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名義の扱いと持参資料の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll discuss whether a name including the trading name can be used. I'd like the documents looked at today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request checking the account-name rules and your documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの担当席へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the officer's consultation desk here. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 総菜の値札をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the prepared-food price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このサラダは三百円ですか。パックには四百八十円と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚札とパック価格の差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this salad 300 yen? The pack says 480 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the shelf-tag and pack-price difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚の値札は百グラム当たりです。パックは百六十グラム入りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The shelf tag is per 100 grams. The pack contains 160 grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 量で値段が変わるのですね。二人で少しずつ食べるので、小さいパックはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 量で変わると理解し小分け商品を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the price changes with quantity. Two of us will have a little each; is there a small pack?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand pricing by quantity and look for a smaller portion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに百グラム入りがあります。同じサラダです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here's a 100-gram pack of the same salad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらなら三百円ですね。容器の重さも含めた百グラムですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 百グラム価格と容器重量の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then this is 300 yen. Does the 100 grams include the container's weight?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the 100-gram price and how container weight is handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示は中身の重さです。容器の分は除いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The label is the contents' weight. The container is excluded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。隣のポテトサラダも同じ単位ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隣の商品の価格単位を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Is the potato salad next to it priced in the same units?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the pricing unit for the adjacent product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そちらは一パックの値段です。値札の下に単位が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That one is per pack. Units are written below the tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 単位を見分けられました。最初のサラダの百グラム入りを一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単位を判断し小さいパックを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can distinguish the units now. I'll buy one 100-gram pack of the first salad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Judge the units and choose the smaller pack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take this one.
